description: UAV-BS Integration with Urban Infrastructure: An Energy Efficiency Prespective is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Balaji Kirubakaran. The integration of uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs)with fifth-generation (5G) cellular networks has been a prominentresearch focus in recent years and continues to attract significantinterest in the context of sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks.UAVs can serve as aerial wireless platforms to provide on-demandcoverage, mobile edge computing, and enhanced sensing andcommunication services. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
